messages:
Maya Patel: Quick heads-up — Day 0 ops for the annual planning offsite is next Friday. Need owners for: exec sync facilitation, AV/runbook lead, and someone to own the 15m executive pre-brief at 08:00. Also we should confirm backup Zoom + recording permissions. Who can take what?

Jonas Lee: I can take AV/runbook lead. I'll check with facilities re: mics and dongles. Will add a short checklist.

Priya Desai: I'll run the exec sync facilitation. Planning a 40m agenda: 10m context, 20m priorities + tradeoffs, 10m decisions. Who from exec will join? @Diane (CEO) ?

Diane (CEO): I'll be there for the decisions block. Can we make sure the decision doc is pre-shared by EOD Thu?

Maya Patel: Yep — decision doc deadline EOD Thu. @Kelly Tran please make sure product priorities are summarized in 1 pager.

Kelly Tran: On it. Will post a 1-pager in the planning folder by Thu 5pm and ping execs. Also will prep a 2-slide backup for each initiative in case we need detail.

Sahil Rao: Ops note — we need an engineer to whitelist recording in Zoom + ensure no PII in screenshots. I can handle whitelist and test recording at 07:30 day-of.

Jonas Lee: AV/runbook checklist draft (will flesh out tonight):

```
- Room: Main Hall A, projector + 2 wireless mics
- Backup room: Conference B with HDMI adapter kit
- Zoom: Host account = product_offsite@redwood.com, record to cloud, CC security for retention policy
- Test schedule: 07:30 engineer test, 08:00 exec pre-brief check-in
- On-call: Jonas (AV), Sahil (Zoom), OpsBot will post reminders
```

Priya Desai: Exec pre-brief plan: 08:00 in small huddle room (15m) — quick run of talking points, who covers which decision, and handoff to Diane. Execs invited: Diane, CTO, Head of Revenue. Please come with top 2 asks per initiative.

Maya Patel: Slight ask — can we keep the exec pre-brief to strictly 15m? Execs are tight. If discussions spill, flag and move to decision table at 10:30.

Diane (CEO): 15m is fine. Priya, please call out which decisions require exec-level sign-off vs. director-level.

Kelly Tran: Noted. I'll mark decisions in the doc as "exec" vs "director" and add a quick rationale sentence.

Sahil Rao: I'll run a recording test Wed 18:00 to ensure cloud recording + captions work. OpsBot, can you post a reminder 24h and 2h before?

OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: 24h before (1971914834) and 2h before (197200; placeholder will be replaced). :white_check_mark:

Jonas Lee: Also small request — catering needs a separate table near AV for laptop prep. Facilities said they'd need a headcount by Thu noon. I'll collect RSVPs.

Maya Patel: Great. Owners recap: Priya = exec sync facilitation & pre-brief, Jonas = AV/runbook, Sahil = Zoom/recording test, Kelly = product 1-pager + decision markings. I'll follow up with calendar invites and the EOD Thu doc deadline. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Priya Desai: Quick follow — can we add a 10m rapid-fire customer ask lane after the decisions block? We often get last-minute asks and want to capture them.

Diane (CEO): Yes, capture them but label as "parking lot" — no exec commitment without follow-up.

Maya Patel: Agreed. Add a parking-lot slide and action-owner field. Last note: anyone who needs bespoke AV (mac adapters, dongles) DM Jonas.

Kelly Tran: Will DM. Closing loop: I'll post the 1-pager and decision doc link here once uploaded.

Maya Patel: Thanks all — will send a short runbook and final invite tomorrow morning.
